style: Hand-painted dark-fantasy card game illustration. Thick, visible painterly brush strokes, muted earthy palette of wet clay browns, slate greys and moss greens, with warm rust-orange and amber accents. Dramatic rim lighting, soft painted background, slightly stylized chunky proportions. No text, no letters, no frame, no border, no watermark.
golem: THE GOLEM: a hulking, hunched construct made of muddy river clay and rough mossy boulders, held together by rusted iron bands and rivets, dripping wet mud, a single glowing amber ember-eye in a boulder head, cracks in its body glowing faintly orange.
